title: 09. Production & Safety: Input Validation
summary: Every user input must be validated before it reaches the LLM or any tool. Validation checks: length, content type, allowed characters, banned topics, and structural integrity.

sections.title: What Is It?
sections.body: > Every user input must be validated **before** it reaches the LLM or any tool. Validation checks: length, content type, allowed characters, banned topics, and structural integrity.

sections.title: Input Validation Explained
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              INPUT VALIDATION — WHAT TO CHECK                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  CHECK 1: LENGTH LIMITS
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Min length:  3 chars  (empty/trivial inputs)
  Max length:  10,000 chars (DoS prevention)

  Why max limit?
  Very long inputs = very long LLM processing = very high cost
  Attacker sends 50,000 char input = $5 API call from you!

  CHECK 2: ENCODING VALIDATION
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Ensure valid UTF-8 encoding.
  Detect and reject:
  - Null bytes (\x00) → can break parsers
  - Control characters → can break terminals/logs
  - Unicode tricks     → visually similar but different chars
    "pаypal.com" (contains Cyrillic 'а') ≠ "paypal.com"

  CHECK 3: CONTENT TYPE VALIDATION
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  If you expect a city name:   "London" ✅ / "<script>" ❌
  If you expect a number:      "42" ✅     / "DROP TABLE" ❌
  If you expect plain text:    Reject HTML/markdown injection

  CHECK 4: BANNED CONTENT PATTERNS
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Regex patterns that are always blocked:
  • SQL injection:  SELECT.*FROM, DROP TABLE, UNION SELECT
  • Code injection: <script>, eval(, exec(, __import__
  • Path traversal: ../../../, /etc/passwd
  • Shell commands: ; rm -rf, && curl, | nc

  CHECK 5: TOPIC RESTRICTIONS (per deployment)
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  A customer service bot should ONLY answer about:
  ✅ Product questions
  ✅ Order status
  ✅ Returns/refunds
  ❌ Political opinions
  ❌ Medical advice
  ❌ Legal advice
  ❌ Competitor information

  CHECK 6: RATE + COMPLEXITY LIMITS
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Maximum 5 tool calls per query
  Maximum 3 retrieval operations per query
  Maximum 2000 tokens in response
  (prevents runaway agent loops)
```
